subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “The city art center held a drawing contest with a new rule: students could use AI tools, but…”?
options: A student wrote an article explaining how much water the fountain used and why the city had made the decision.
Every summer, the City Science Museum holds a Night at the Museum event for students aged twelve to fifteen.
A student group used the data to make a map of bus stops without shade.
One student used AI to create five versions of a city at night, then combined the best parts into her own painting.

本文沒有陳述「A student group used the data to make a map of bus stops without shade.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
